models_evaluated: Computer vision AI algorithm for HIVST result interpretation (trained on lab-captured images)

links.outcome: AI sensitivity, specificity, PPV, NPV versus clients and pharmacy providers against expert panel ground truth
links.effect: AI: 100% sensitivity, 100% NPV, 98.8% specificity, 81.5% PPV (seven false positives). Clients/providers: sensitivity 93.2%/97.7%, NPV 99.6%/99.9%, specificity and PPV 100%.
links.quote: The AI algorithm demonstrated perfect sensitivity (100%), perfect NPV (100%), and 98.8% specificity, and 81.5% PPV (81.5%) due to seven false-positive results.

unlisted_practices: Using AI computer vision as quality assurance for human interpretation of self-test results

screen.reason: Evaluates computer vision performance on photos of HIV self-tests collected prospectively in pharmacies compared to human interpretation and expert panel ground truth, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or intervention.
